I’ve had the chance to see this ecosystem from the different sides - enterprises, agent startups, data providers, labs. The core tension here is that the business models, moats, value exchange, execution playbooks for all players are being figured out in real time. This debate around token pricing is really a debate over where value will accrue - models, application layer, distribution or other layers. Expect a lot of strong opinions from the different sides to shape the narrative in their favor.
